_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::input_format#2. Upstream fsi_fp_mono_fs_ga_ga.4C.yaml keeps the structure and fluid interface nodes separate (17-20 duplicating 13-16 at identical coordinates) and exits 0 with 6 result tests CORRECT. The probe changes exactly one thing — the structure element is rewired from nodes 17-20 onto the fluid's 13-16, the orphaned copies are deleted and the topology renamed — and asserts that not one condition block was touched (ONLY_THE_MESH_WAS_EDITED=yes). That alone turns the run into exit 1 with '3 DOFs given but 4 expected in Volume Dirichlet boundary condition' from core/fem/src/discretization/4C_fem_discretization_utils_dbc.cpp line 292: the structure's NUMDOF-3 volume Dirichlet is now read on the fluid discretisation, where the shared node carries 4 DOFs. There is no NUMDOF that rescues it — declaring that block with NUMDOF 4 just moves the complaint to the next condition on the same nodes ('3 DOFs given but 4 expected in Point Dirichlet boundary condition'). Two corrections: the entry's 'inconsistent NUMDOF on shared node' does not exist (0 occurrences) and the failure never comes from 4C_io_input_spec.cpp (BLAMED_INPUT_SPEC_CPP=0) — it is a runtime DOF check inside the DBC extractor, not a parse check. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
